title: Cold rebuild: Aggregate the answers
summary: Rebuild Aggregate the answers from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Aggregate the answers** in *Splitter, aggregator and enricher*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.title: Rebuild Aggregate the answers cold
prompt: Each split part was checked against the warehouse. The answers come back **in any order, interleaved across orders**.
`string? Offer(string orderId, int expected, string isbn, bool inStock)`:
- return `null` until `expected` answers for that order have arrived;
- on the completing answer return `"{orderId}: {n}/{expected} in stock"`, followed, if any are missing, by `" missing "` and the out-of-stock ISBNs sorted and joined with `,`:
- then **forget** the group, so memory does not grow (a later answer for the same id starts a new group).
- `int OpenGroups` returns how many groups are waiting.
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
Type the shape yourself, then fill it in:
public string? Offer(string orderId, int expected, string isbn, bool inStock)
